name: Duet Smart Effector
description: The Duet Smart Effector is a strain-gauge based Z probe designed for delta 3D printers. It replaces the standard effector plate and uses an array of resistive strain gauges to detect when the nozzle contacts the bed surface. This provides zero XY offset probing with excellent repeatability, purpose-built for delta kinematics.

electricalSpecs.signalType: digital (strain gauge array with onboard processing)

physicalSpecs.mountType: replaces delta effector plate (3x ball joint mount)
